description: This file contains JavaScript code for interacting with a backend API in a frontend application. It includes functions to resolve the API base URL, fetch JSON data from various endpoints, and provide module exports for dashboard overview and metrics data.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves a reliable API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a given URL with error handling.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a modules overview for the dashboard, trying multiple endpoints and deriving minimal data if necessary.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated totals for the overview screen, including total users and deployed applications.
